notes: Iron Atronachs first appeared in a demo of Mephala's Realm during an episode of ESO Live. The name of the creature wasn't known until the release of the Legends card.
The NPC form of Iron Atronachs is available to players via the Iron Atronach polymorph collectible.
An Iron Atronach is available as a training dummy.
An Iron Atronach polymorph is available.
Non-interactable Iron Atronachs in The Deadlands are found spitting lava from out-of-bounds areas.
The Spirit of Mount Firesong and the Avatar of Mount Firesong use the polymorph instead of the traditional Iron Atronach model.

summary: Iron Atronachs are a type of atronach composed of partially-molten iron. They are first encountered in the Forgotten Wastes. Iron atronachs are also summoned by dragons at Dragonscours in Northern and Southern Elsweyr, and the Magma Queen in Vateshran Hollows. They can also spawn at Volcanic Vents on High Isle and Galen. Some iron atronachs in The Burn are situated on elevated cliffs, spewing fireballs downward. These cannot be accessed or attacked directly. Iron Atronach names begin with the word "Mynar".
